text_block_list.text:
—Summer arrived. A season that neither of 
them would ever forget.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh... The reason for my slump is because 
I'm carrying too much on my own...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, Trainer...! From now on, we 
do this together!

By becoming a true duo sharing 
responsibility, Super Creek broke out of 
her slump.

Ever since then, the distance between the 
two had closed a bit. And this year...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you seem a little different. Is 
it because you're in better shape than 
last year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's not all. Her expression looks 
somehow more intrepid, too...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I have somewhat mixed feelings about this♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Part of me wished things stayed as 
they were, while another part is happy. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we can't stop things from changing. 
Not you, not me, not what's between us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not afraid. Because I believe 
that no matter how things change, 
everything will be all right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what kind of summer shall we 
make this as we look toward the autumn G1 
races? Fufu.

I swore to the blue sky that I would run 
through this once-in-a-lifetime summer 
without regrets.
